svg.desc: Gradient boosting as a sequence: start from the mean, compute residuals, fit a stump to them, add it with a shrinkage factor, recompute residuals, and repeat for M rounds. A curve shows the training loss falling with each round.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gradient boosting: each tree fits what is still wrong

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Squared loss: the negative gradient at the current prediction is the residual.
